g.title: None.None.Node.1
g.text: Google Cloud video processing with the Transcoder API, Workflows and Cloud CDN

g.title: None.None.Node.3
g.text: A signed-in creator starts an upload in the studio API, which returns a signed URL
The browser uploads the source video straight to Cloud Storage
which creates a Transcoder API job from the HLS and DASH template
The job writes the bitrate ladder and manifests to the renditions bucket
and reports its state to Pub/Sub, which the workflow waits on
The workflow runs a job to make thumbnails
and marks the title ready in the Firestore catalogue
The player's host name resolves in Cloud DNS to the global load balancer
The catalogue API on Cloud Run lists titles and signs a CDN cookie
Segments stream from the renditions bucket through Cloud CDN
Watch events go through Pub/Sub to BigQuery for viewing analytics
